name: WindowScopeProvider
description: Supplies the current scope and how to draw a scope to the window layer's scope chips and dock groups. A null or undefined `value` turns scope labelling off.
signature: ({ value, children }: { value: WindowScopes | null | undefined; children: ReactNode; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
